svg.title: Example: Ageing WIP & Service Level Expectation
svg.desc: Worked example for a fictional team. A3 landscape board: ageing WIP chart by column, cycle time data with percentiles, the team's service level expectation, and actions for ageing items.
svg.text: See how old each open item is compared with how long work usually takes, and act before it's late.
Manage Flow · Work Item Age · Cycle Time Percentiles · Service Level Expectation
ONE DOT PER OPEN ITEM, IN ITS CURRENT COLUMN
COLUMN NAMES ↑ · IN-PROGRESS COLUMNS ONLY, LEFT TO RIGHT
Draw each percentile as a line across the chart
A FORECAST FOR ONE ITEM, NOT A TARGET
Based on how many items, from when to when:
LOOK AT THE OLDEST ITEMS FIRST, EVERY DAY
Mention it at the daily sync
Ask what's needed to finish it
“Which item is oldest, and what would it take to finish it today?”
“How long does work usually take here, really?”
Manage Flow · Stop Starting, Start Finishing
